metadata.gitb:name: [us.fsma204] Self-test: the shapes accept correct and reject broken passports
metadata.gitb:description: Runs without interaction. Validates the reference passports OpenEPCIS publishes for US FSMA 204 — FDA FSMA §204 Food Traceability Rule (21 CFR 1 Subpart S), which must conform, and a deliberately broken variant, which must NOT. Without the second half a green result would be indistinguishable from empty shapes. Fixtures are pre-expanded N-Quads so the outcome depends on the shapes alone and not on the currently deployed contexts.

success.default: "The us.fsma204 shapes accept every reference passport and reject the broken one."

failure.default: "Self-test failed: either a reference passport was rejected or the broken passport was accepted. Both mean the us.fsma204 shapes are not fit to certify anyone."
